newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-BARCELONA IN TALKS OVER DUTCH GOALKEEPER HESP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA IN TALKS OVER DUTCH GOALKEEPER HESP.

text.p: Barcelona have begun negotiations with Dutch Cup winners Roda JC over the transfer of goalkeeper Ruud Hesp, Dutch media reported on Saturday.
Roda chairman Theo Pickee confirmed the Catalan club's interest in the 31-year-old Hesp, saying a deal could be struck over the weekend.
"I don't know anything about it personally," Hesp told Dutch television. "But I'm hoping for a nice surprise because a contract with Barcelona would be a dream for me."
Vitor Baia is the current first-choice goalkeeper at the Camp Nou but the Portuguese international has had trouble juggling club and country commitments this season.
